instruction: Disable the global play/pause hotkey in VLC preferences

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to VLC preferences (Tools > Preferences > Hotkeys) and disabling the global play/pause hotkey. Uses existing check_global_key_play_pause metric to verify the global-key-play-pause setting is empty (disabled) in the VLC config file. Added postconfig to close VLC so config is saved.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to disable the global play/pause hotkey in VLC
Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly extracts VLC configuration file from ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc
Metric (check_global_key_play_pause) correctly parses the config file and checks if 'global-key-play-pause=' line is empty (disabled)
Metric logic correctly interprets empty value after '=' as disabled (returns '0'), and non-empty as enabled (returns '1')
Expected value '0' correctly represents disabled state according to metric logic
Postconfig appropriately kills VLC to ensure configuration is persisted to disk
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires (disabling global hotkey)
Data flow is correct: config file → parse line → check if empty → compare with expected '0'
